description: This Java source file defines the `NamespaceBlockedException` class, which is an exception thrown when a namespace is blocked. It provides mechanisms for creating, serializing, and deserializing the exception, including custom messages, headers, and handling JSON format. It includes a builder pattern for constructing instances with customizable attributes.

classes.name: NamespaceBlockedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a namespace is blocked. It extends `DittoRuntimeException` and includes methods for creating instances, JSON deserialization, and conversion to a builder for modifications.

classes.name: NamespaceBlockedException.Builder
classes.description: A private static nested class implementing a mutable builder pattern for constructing `NamespaceBlockedException` instances with fluent API, ensuring thread safety is not required.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new exception builder with a message stating that the namespace is blocked, based on the provided namespace string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a `NamespaceBlockedException` from a JSON object, given headers.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mutable builder pre-populated with the current exception's data, allowing modifications.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Creates a new exception instance with the specified headers, copying other data from the current instance.
